title: scheduler/: a Go service in a Podman container that reads the records of the state root, applies the routes and policies tables, runs every action as a retried job through the host executor, confirms wakes, calls stalls on two signals
text: One module, one binary: run, exec, status, parity, check. It mounts the repository read-only and the state root read-write, acts only through the executor socket, and runs every domain loop under one supervised unit. Revised 2026-10-13 (SPEC-16 1.1.0): the title said it reads the record log and the text mounted its own state directory; runtime data left git for the state root (cards C10, C11), so it reads the records tree of the state root and writes its ledger, jobs and latches there. SPEC-16 is the engine and the end state (owner 2026-10-13 02:50Z), so every domain loop runs inside this one binary under one systemd user unit and no reconciler gets its own unit, process or pane. Rejected: one unit per reconciler (every unit is one more thing to supervise and one more way for the line to half-run). Cost: a crash in one domain loop restarts them all, which the binary's recovery on start (SPEC-16.F) makes safe.
